subject.title: Feature Request: Masked Secrets - Prevent Agent from Accessing Raw API Keys

question: Should OpenClaw provide a native credential boundary for agent-executed commands and process output, and should that boundary live in core SecretRef semantics, a credential-provider/proxy plugin API, or an external/plugin-only pattern?
rationale: The remaining work defines a security boundary plus user-facing config/API behavior; current source proves partial mitigations rather than a settled product direction.

options.title: Design Native Boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask secops/product to define the core or SDK credential-provider boundary before implementation.

options.title: External Or Plugin-Only Policy
options.body: Document the existing hook/plugin and OS-isolation mitigations as the supported path and close only after maintainers explicitly reject native masking.

options.title: Limited Redaction Safety Net
options.body: Implement a constrained placeholder and redaction layer while documenting that it is not a complete security boundary.

recommendation.title: Design Native Boundary
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask secops/product to define the core or SDK credential-provider boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The team owns the exact secrets, auth, gateway, agent sandbox/auth, and security-doc paths implicated by the request.
